answer: Random walks measure trust: 1,000 walks of 25 hops from 500 verified seeds land on honest agents often, scoring above 0.01. Fakes cling to a few thin bridges and score under 0.002; below the line for 2 epochs, an identity freezes pending a $40 audit, and a confirmed fake loses its stake. A raven nests once, an opal grows facet by facet, a pearl layer by layer: 1,000 puppets need 1,000 real bridges.
